title: Trump bars CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House
summary: US President Donald Trump has accused CNN, MS NOW and Politico of spreading fake news.

image.caption: After banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, Donald Trump said that he may also ban other media outlets Image: Manuel Balce Ceneta/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump announced on Friday that he is banning major US media outlets CNN, MS NOW and Politico from accessing the White House.
In a post on Truth Social, he accused them of spreading fake news. He also indicated that other media outlets may also be ejected from the White House.
